nfl.oneThing: Marvin Harrison Jr. is headed from the Cardinals to the Texans, one of the first big moves ahead of the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

headlines.title: Cardinals send Marvin Harrison Jr. to the Texans
headlines.summary: Arizona is trading Harrison to Houston. A feature looks at what his trade value could look like and how players have fared after a fresh start.
headlines.whyItMatters: Arizona is 1–3 and Houston is 1–4, so both teams are early in their seasons and the deal may change how they approach the rest of the year.

headlines.title: Commanders and Giants tie 27–27 after a costly end to overtime
headlines.summary: Jayden Daniels scrambled on an ill-advised play in the closing seconds of overtime, with Washington in field goal range. The Commanders could not stop the clock before time ran out.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Giants (3–1–1) lead the NFC East and Washington (1–3–1) is near the bottom, so the tie matters more for Washington's season than for New York's.

headlines.title: Jets end three-game skid with 17–12 win over Browns
headlines.summary: Braelon Allen ran 22 yards for the go-ahead touchdown late in the fourth quarter after New York recovered a fumbled punt snap. The Jets' defence and special teams also held up in the rain.
headlines.whyItMatters: The win lifts the Jets to 2–3 and stops a three-game losing run, while Cleveland drops to 3–2 after losing its first game since...

headlines.title: Jaguars beat Eagles 19–17 with a 57-yard winner
headlines.summary: Jacksonville's emergency long snapper, nose tackle DaVon Hamilton, delivered the snap on Cam Little's game-winning 57-yard field goal.
headlines.whyItMatters: Jacksonville moves to 4–1 and sits second in the AFC playoff picture.

contextCard.title: How the NFL trade deadline works
contextCard.body: The trade deadline is the cutoff for trading players during the season. Once it passes, teams can still sign free agents and make waiver claims, but they can't trade players with each other. This year's deadline is Nov. 10.

nba.oneThing: Kyrie Irving scored 17 points in his first game back with the Mavericks, a 132–115 preseason win over the Rockets in Macao.

headlines.title: Kyrie Irving returns to the Mavericks
headlines.summary: Irving scored 17 points in his first game in 586 days. Dallas beat Houston 132–115 in preseason, and the offence looked more cohesive with him back.
headlines.whyItMatters: The regular season hasn't started yet, so this is an early read on how Dallas might look once games count.

headlines.title: Kings lose Maxime Raynaud to a right knee injury
headlines.summary: Raynaud suffered what appeared to be a serious right knee injury in the preseason loss to the Warriors. He will be reevaluated in two weeks.
headlines.whyItMatters: Sacramento's season has not started, so the full impact is not yet clear.

headlines.title: Karl-Anthony Towns 'disappointed' with Knicks tabling talks
headlines.summary: The Knicks said they are tabling all extension talks until later in the season. Towns said he was disappointed.
headlines.whyItMatters: With talks on hold, the extension question stays open for now.

headlines.title: Raptors beat Clippers 114–106 in first game after Kawhi trade
headlines.summary: Toronto's first preseason game since the Kawhi Leonard trade ended in a 114–106 win over the Clippers.
headlines.whyItMatters: It is only a preseason result, but it is the first look at Toronto after the trade.
